title: The Coal Under the Broken Pot

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour. It lifts the lid with the back of a hand and tips the coal, and does not look to see what it mended. The fire takes; the fifth pull is still missing, and nobody says whose.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail hearth, told at the first firing of Smoke

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and forty to two hundred and forty-two days, six months and sixty days to six months and sixty-two days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing; the widow's mark opened like a vessel before the kiln and put behind the household without a name; the dressed grain's read figure held apart from the figure paid and from the cost of hands and damp; the question opened as a surgeon opens a wound and found to have no witness at the bottom; the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no fifth telling of the burned slate, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no fourth shaping of the pot saying, no fifth witness or fifth asking to the question, no eighth green or eighth shape, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no calling of the loan, no payer named for the carried fire's fifth or the first opening of Smoke, no private record read, no figure given for the dressed grain or the hand that did not come back, no name spoken over the green or the shape, no sale or betrayal paid, no lesson made of the opening and no ending

scenes.title: The Hand at the Mark
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 240, Smoke 1, Firstday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth and the kiln mouth. No recap: the hand lay down against the fold after the fifty-fourth answer and that coordination is set down like a tool, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. Count exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody at 239 going into **240**, six months and sixty days, told by nobody (T071/T072); first smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. Smoke comes on without a boundary drawn; neither of the district's two month-names is corrected; no market, no Cross and no bell until Smoke 10 (Day 249). Three counts in three places --- the carried fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should be under the floor (payer unnamed two hundred and forty days, T088), the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- none rising into another, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). Body inventory: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. The file is turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh in two hundred and forty days and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings on their own places, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's third arithmetic unread under this roof and the true subtraction in Berr's locked box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, returning-line place gone around with no number, and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and not paid:** for the first firing of Smoke Sella goes to the kiln mouth before anything else and puts her hand to the widow's mark at her throat, holds it one breath, lets go, lifts the clay lid with the back of a hand and tips the carried coal under the back of a broken pot; the fire takes, still answering four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should be, its payer unnamed for two hundred and forty days; nobody praises the opening and nobody sees what it mended; no slate entered, no lesson made, no bond changed hands and no payer named. Sixty days of going around end in one held breath; she does not touch the mark again at a shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on any of the three days, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour, the rule holding exactly as on Tallow 1 and Ember 1 (T058/T079). Her ordinary grammar follows: instruction to wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, *the house*, *The house will keep it*, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, grey streak pale off the coals (T100). First hand question of the chapter and the **fifty-fifth** answer --- down at once under conditions that have sometimes answered --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Four Pulls and a Gap
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 240, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the back room (rendered only as a direction and a sound), the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The opening is not recalled as a sign or looked at again; the house takes up its ordinary grammar. Afternoon thins without ending; heat settles under the low angle, behind the pot, into the fold where one stiff brown-edged barley crust lies two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow seat with its twenty-year lean, clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw unswept, proverb gone years ago to a pot with no crack, tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken two hundred and forty days; no collector came up or went down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence comes to his teeth and goes all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name --- a remembered stopping, not a new one --- nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath is drawn and not spent, the loan is uncalled, no collector came on Smoke 1, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot reaching him only as a sound with a direction (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip; dusty and clean forearms on one tray; broken birth-slates under the lowest rack entered by nobody; speaks to the wheel before anyone (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*) and tells a pot *You'll do*; knows the full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; the burned-slate word stands at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and do not become three; no name for the men who went low into the room before first grey and none for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188; when Sella's sentence goes low his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of it, takes the cold out, holds until the end arrives at the pot, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing --- a remembered repetition, not a change made again, paired with no other fraction, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. Second hand question and **fifty-sixth** answer --- held for the small intake only and down before the letting-go --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named. At the going of the light Sella carries him home at the half-pace from every open slate, going wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, sets him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen and goes to her own bed before the small hours. Small hours: no breathing number anywhere in the house; fire, river and boards keep three counts that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T088, T071/T072).

scenes.title: The Cover Stays
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 241, Smoke 2, Secondday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks and the Clay Yard. New day, new date, no recap: **241** exact, six months and sixty-one days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-one days (T088); widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no other hour --- not at a shelf, a well, a rack or a basket on this morning (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross, for Smoke 10 (Day 249) stands eight mornings ahead. The dressed grain is turned under its wool for damp, looked at, spread thin to finish and gathered back by the handful, the fold set flat; it changes state and gains no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). A neighbour at the threshold asks what the storing will take now the grain is under wool and Sella sends the question to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere; the figure read over the covered grain on Grain 30 is still not the figure paid, and the true subtraction stays locked in Berr's box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T015/T041/T047 held). Sella lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). Third hand question and **fifty-seventh** answer --- down before the counted breath had finished --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082). No eighth green and no eighth shape; no second look joined, no name spoken over either, no loaf, slate or sale; no fifth asking over the boards and no witness to the four askings; no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause and no finger drawn between absences (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held as sightings only, T101 carried, T098 carried).

scenes.title: The Knife at the Lip
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 241, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the boards fronting the shelf, the hearth, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. THE CHAPTER'S SECOND ADVANCEMENT, a held coordination and not a change made again. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; crust, empty place, frozen thread, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-one days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence reaches the calling word and stops as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name; nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath is drawn and not spent, the loan is uncalled, the collector's road is swept over without once turning along it, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra at the wheel-shed: dust ground meal-fine past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, speaks to the wheel and tells a pot *You'll do*, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; burned slate at four and shut-room tellings at two, no fifth and no third; bent finger in the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, the iron one piece with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; men unnamed into the back room before first grey, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise ungiven and not withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Fourth hand question and **fifty-eighth** answer --- held through a whole counted breath at Sella's fire in the room that does not touch his and down with the breath, the old two-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named and no doctrine stood up out of it (T061/T082). Small hours: the fire misses its fifth with no payer for two hundred and forty-one days, the river keeps its low note, the boards keep four nails, four and a knot, and the three counts do not become one (T088, T071/T072).

scenes.title: Nothing Priced
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 242, Smoke 3, Thirdday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks and the Clay Yard. New day, new date, no recap: **242** exact, six months and sixty-two days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-two days (T088); the widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no other hour on this morning, not at a shelf, a well, a rack, a basket or a pot (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin and gathered back by the handful, the fold set flat; it changes state and gains no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). A woman at the threshold with a pot asks what the storing will take and is sent to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number out of a fist toward the yard well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere. A wrong wind comes up off High Kiln: the sweet edge of lead glaze rides over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it --- a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid --- and one of the three shapings of the pot saying is let stand again as a saying; three likenesses must not stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands to these; no pot was lost, no fourth likeness made a cause and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T064, held). Sella lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). Fifth hand question and **fifty-ninth** answer --- held to the river's own low interval with no count in the house to borrow and down on the next low note --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named; water over water stays a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings (T061/T082). Seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, no second look joined, no name spoken over either, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration, no loaf, slate or sale and no romance paid (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held).

scenes.title: The Sixth Place
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 242, Smoke 3, Thirdday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. Smoke goes out without a boundary drawn in the narration; neither of the district's two names for the months is corrected; Smoke 10 (Day 249), the first Account-day and market of the second firing, stands beyond the close and is not brought early. Afternoon thins without ending; heat into the fold; crust, empty place, frozen thread, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting. Garl in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-two days, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 1, 2 or 3 (T009/T013/T092). Sella gives the fire its instruction before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, stands counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark as it was after the one opening before the kiln on Smoke 1 --- touched at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on any of these three days, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour; the opening is put behind the household with no lesson made, no payer named and nothing settled (T058/T079, T100). Dressed grain covered and unfigured under wool near the hearth, counted in glances and handfuls and by an arm that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate. Tarn at the kindling: instructed broom, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, knife at the very edge with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered stopping, nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra at the wheel-shed: dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, note known three turns ahead and withheld, burned slate at four and shut-room tellings at two, bent finger in the damper as a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise ungiven, men unnamed (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Small hours: no breathing number anywhere in the house; fire four low pulls and missing fifth with payer unnamed two hundred and forty-two days, river note of water over water, boards four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- three counts in three places that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T088, T071/T072). Turn out the file as instruments on a towel: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh in two hundred and forty-two days and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, fourth burned-slate telling, two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's third arithmetic unread under this roof and the true subtraction locked beyond it, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the carried man's pale line and the held inch, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered, returning-line place gone around with a look and no number, and on its seventh place the question with four askings and no witness --- four askings still not one witness, no fifth asking and no row named (T101 carried, T098 carried). Sixth hand question and **sixtieth** answer --- up an inch toward the river's note through the finger's-width door, through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of the breaths Sella counts at her fire in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and down on the river's next low note --- two rhythms across a wall that does not touch, remembered, not a change made again; filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh of the full note, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082). Sixty answers stand there now, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air. Close the ledger of the day: **242** exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; six months and sixty-two days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days; widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no other hour; seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; Smoke gone out without a boundary and the first Account-day of the second firing standing beyond the close.
